items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Then after Eddie Gilmore got out, we had taken Simon, Simon Moreira.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. That was our original band.

Then after Eddie Gilmore got out, we had taken Simon, Simon Moreira. He played with us a long time. Then after Buddy Manaday got out, we had taken Guy A.C. Butler Rapp and he stayed with us about three years and I left in 25 and that's when I went to the roof garden from 25 to 26 and I left and I left from 25 to 27, Manuel Perez. And after I left Manuel Perez, I went down to the La Vida.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Me and Guy A. Butler rap, and a little T-boy, you know, Gilmore, you know, the bass.

ctx.x: And there's a fine rhythm section. And my buddy had a good rhythm section. Me and Guy A. Butler rap, and a little T-boy, you know, Gilmore, you know, the bass. He had a nice, nice, sometimes Simon, you see. He had a nice rhythm section. Well, the manuals band, you see, I never did hear their band. See, they always played down the Creole, like Ranzami, you know, halls like that.
Perrae, you too? Yeah, yeah, Perrae.
